# Amcards

AMCards enables users to create personalized greeting cards, automate mailing campaigns, strengthen customer relationships using a convenient online platform for individualized connections

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/amcards/.

## Actions

- **Get Cards** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all cards associated with the authenticated account.
- **Get Contacts** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of contacts from amcards.
